title: Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback as Thermodynamic Entropy Minimisation: A Formal Isomorphism and Testable Predictions
description: The paper shows that the RLHF objective with a KL penalty is algebraically identical to minimizing Helmholtz free energy in statistical mechanics, mapping reward to negative energy, policy to a Boltzmann distribution, and the KL coefficient to temperature. From this formal isomorphism it derives three falsifiable predictions about optimal temperature scaling with task entropy, grokking as a first‑order phase transition, and a universal alignment–capability bound, offering testable thermodynamic design principles for RLHF.

rlhf_objective.description: RLHF objective with KL regularization to a reference policy; maximizing J trades off reward and divergence from the reference.

kl_divergence.description: Definition of the KL divergence between the learned policy and the reference policy at a state s.

optimal_policy_boltzmann.description: Closed-form optimal policy under the KL-regularized objective; a Boltzmann distribution with energy −R and temperature T = \beta_{KL}.

free_energy_equivalence.latex: J = \mathbb{E}[R] + \beta_{\mathrm{KL}}\, H(\pi) + \beta_{\mathrm{KL}}\, \mathbb{E}[\ln \pi_{\mathrm{ref}}] = -F + \text{const},\quad F=\langle E\rangle - T S
free_energy_equivalence.description: Exact identity mapping the RLHF objective to negative Helmholtz free energy with substitutions R\to -E and \beta_{KL}\to T (k_B=1).

jailbreak_rate.description: Arrhenius/Kramers-like escape probability over a free-energy barrier \Delta F for prompt p with effective temperature T_eff.

alignment_capability_bound.description: Proposed universal trade-off bound between alignment (A) and capability (C) governed by free-energy improvements at temperature T.

grokking_latency.description: Prediction that the grokking stall period scales with the entropy gap between memorization and generalization basins, modulated by effective temperature.

key_results.main_finding: RLHF with a KL penalty is exactly isomorphic to thermodynamic free-energy minimization, yielding Boltzmann-optimal policies and three falsifiable predictions about temperature scaling, grokking dynamics, and an alignment–capability bound.

sealed_predictions.statement: Optimal KL temperature scales with task entropy: \beta_{\mathrm{KL}}^* \propto H_{\mathrm{task}}^{-1/2}.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Train comparable models across task families with systematically varied entropy; if the optimum \beta_{KL} shows no dependence on H_task (or opposite scaling), the prediction is falsified.

sealed_predictions.statement: Grokking is a first-order-like transition with a latent period that scales as \Delta t_{\mathrm{grok}} \propto (H_{\mathrm{mem}} - H_{\mathrm{gen}})/T_{\mathrm{eff}}.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Construct controlled datasets (e.g., modular arithmetic with varying modulus) and measure stall periods; a correlation r < 0.3 between predicted and observed latencies falsifies the claim.

sealed_predictions.statement: A universal alignment–capability bound holds: A\cdot C \le 1 - \exp(-(F_0 - F^*)/T), setting a maximum attainable product across \beta_{KL} sweeps.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Across families of models varying \beta_{KL}, if empirical A\cdot C reliably exceeds the bound (beyond uncertainty) or grows monotonically without saturating below the bound, the prediction is falsified.

kill_criteria: KC1: Systematic failure of the Boltzmann optimal policy form (Eq. 3): for RLHF with a KL penalty, if fitted policies across diverse states cannot be well-approximated by \pi^*(a|s) \propto \pi_ref(a|s)\exp(R/\beta_{KL}) with any global temperature (out-of-sample KL improvement < 1% over non-Boltzmann baselines), the isomorphism is falsified.

KC2: Breakdown of the free-energy identity (Eq. 4): if measured J, E[R], H(\pi), and E[\ln \pi_ref] disagree with J = E[R] + \beta_{KL}H(\pi) + \beta_{KL}E[\ln \pi_ref] to within estimation error, or do not transform as −F + const under R\to -E and \beta_{KL}\to T, the mapping fails.

KC3: Temperature non-equivalence: if varying \beta_{KL} does not produce the same policy reweighting as changing sampling temperature in the Boltzmann form (after accounting for \pi_ref), i.e., no consistent global T maps \beta_{KL} to temperature, the mapping is falsified.

KC4: P1 falsified at scale: across multiple task families with quantifiably different H_task, the optimal \beta_{KL} shows no dependence on H_task (|slope| not significantly different from 0; pooled r^2 < 0.1), invalidating the temperature–entropy scaling.
KC5: P2 falsified: measured grokking stall periods across controlled datasets exhibit correlation r < 0.3 with the predicted (H_mem − H_gen)/T_eff, contradicting the phase-transition account.

KC6: P3 falsified: observed A·C exceeds the proposed bound 1 − exp(−(F0 − F*)/T) by a statistically significant margin across a \beta_{KL} sweep, or increases monotonically without saturating below the bound.

KC7: Jailbreak Arrhenius breakdown: when \Delta F is manipulated via controlled reward shaping or constitutional constraints, jailbreak probability fails to show an approximately exponential dependence on −\Delta F/T_eff.
abstract: RLHF is formally isomorphic to statistical-mechanical entropy minimisation. Reward maps to negative energy, policy to Boltzmann distribution, beta_KL to temperature, RLHF objective to negative Helmholtz free energy. Three falsifiable predictions: optimal temperature scaling, grokking as first-order phase transition, and universal alignment-capability bound.

design_principles: Task-matched temperature: set beta_KL from H_task, not grid search
Annealed alignment: high T early (capability), low T late (alignment crystallisation)
Landscape architecture: Constitutional AI shapes Delta F barriers
Jailbreak resistance is exponential: modest Delta F increase -> exponential P(jailbreak) decrease

ledger_impact.holistic_analysis: This paper formalizes a precise isomorphism between RLHF with a KL penalty and thermodynamic free-energy minimization, yielding sealed, falsifiable predictions about temperature scaling, grokking dynamics, and an alignment–capability bound. For EFC, it strengthens the universality claim that entropy/energy-flow principles govern diverse systems, opening a cross-domain validation channel without closing any current cosmology-specific KCs or theory gaps.

No prior 1–2 hop related papers were linked, so this paper seeds a new cross-domain subgraph that can host future validation edges.
